mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "Latest" = the current rolling window (roughly the last 10 months, newest day first, ~2,200 notices at recon time). "Archived" = the older overflow window the site keeps once items roll off the current page (roughly 2 further months).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many notices are kept in the output for this run. The underlying page is always fetched in full first (there is no server-side pagination), so this only trims what gets saved to the dataset, not how much is downloaded.
